{{Top|leg}}
Following the end of the [[Swarm War]], '''microdroid wrestling''' became a popular sport in many [[Casino/Legends|casinos]]. Hobbyists built [[Microdroid/Legends|microdroids]] to act as miniature [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]]. In each round, two [[Droid/Legends|droid]] combatants fought and the winner moved onto the next round. The actual combat took place in a secure chamber so that spectators were not accidentally injured by the droids.

The [[Maw Casino]] on the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' hosted microdroid wrestling matches, one of which was fought on an artificial battlefield made to resemble [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
